ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached circuit diagram shows an ideal op-amp with negative feedback. The non-inverting (+) input is connected to a node fed from Vi through a resistor R, with a capacitor C from that node to ground. The inverting (-) input is connected to Vi through a resistor R1 and to the output V0 through another resistor R1. Derivation: For the + input node, the resistor R and capacitor impedance 1/(sC) form a low-pass divider, so V+ = Vi * [1/(sC)] / [R + 1/(sC)] = Vi/(1+sRC). For the - input node, the ideal op-amp input current is zero. Applying KCL with the two equal resistors R1 gives (V- - Vi)/R1 + (V- - V0)/R1 = 0, so 2V- - Vi - V0 = 0, hence V0 = 2V- - Vi. With ideal negative feedback, V- = V+. Substituting V+ = Vi/(1+sRC), V0/Vi = 2/(1+sRC) - 1 = (1-sRC)/(1+sRC).

method.method_draft: Model the op-amp part as an amplifier with two contributions. From the image, Rf = Rin = R1, so the contribution from the inverting input source Vi is -(Rf/Rin)Vi = -Vi when the + input reference is fixed. The contribution from the non-inverting terminal voltage V+ is (1+Rf/Rin)V+ = 2V+. The RC network at the + input gives V+ = Vi/(1+sRC). Therefore V0 = 2Vi/(1+sRC) - Vi, so V0/Vi = (1-sRC)/(1+sRC).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个理想运算放大器电路。输入 Vi 分成两路：一路通过电阻 R1 接到反相输入端；输出 V0 通过另一个电阻 R1 反馈到反相输入端，因此反相端的输入电阻和反馈电阻相等。另一路通过电阻 R 接到同相输入端，同相输入端再通过电容 C 接地，形成一阶 RC 低通网络。推理：按照图中连接，反相通道中 Rin = Rf = R1，所以当同相端参考固定时，Vi 对输出的反相贡献为 -(Rf/Rin)Vi = -Vi。同相端电压 V+ 经过 RC 网络得到，电容阻抗为 1/(sC)，所以 V+ = Vi * [1/(sC)] / [R + 1/(sC)] = Vi/(1+sRC)。同相端电压对该闭环放大器的贡献为 (1+Rf/Rin)V+ = 2V+。因此 V0 = 2Vi/(1+sRC) - Vi = Vi[(2/(1+sRC)) - 1] = Vi(1-sRC)/(1+sRC)。所以传递函数为 V0(s)/Vi(s) = (1-sRC)/(1+sRC)。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted transfer function exactly matches the standard answer: (1 - sRC)/(1 + sRC).
